items.title: Align canonical GitHub repo and Vercel project
notes: Verified on 2026-05-25 that Vercel deployment metadata now points to Ajinkya-M/mango.
Verified production branch in Vercel metadata is feat/order-system.

items.title: Choose a long-term production branch strategy for Vercel
notes: Production is currently deploying from feat/order-system.
Decide whether to keep that branch as production or move production tracking to main.

items.title: Replace client-side demo admin auth with server-side protection
notes: Current admin login uses hardcoded credentials in app/admin/page.tsx.
Admin access should be enforced on the server, not by sessionStorage.

items.title: Move products and inventory to persistent server-backed storage
notes: Catalog state is currently browser-local and not shared.
Inventory updates should persist across users and sessions.

items.title: Introduce Zod validation for all server-side write paths
notes: This is part of the architecture rules in AGENTS.md.
Validation should be added once API routes or server actions exist.

items.title: Implement server-side order creation with stock and pricing checks
notes: Do not trust client-side cart totals or product prices.
Recalculate totals and validate stock on the server before accepting orders.

items.title: Break large page components into smaller reusable modules
notes: app/page.tsx and app/admin/page.tsx are currently large monolithic client files.
Refactoring will help once the data model and server boundaries are defined.
